messages:
Maria: Heads-up — running longctx perf harness and hitting a reproducible page-table stall in the KV cache on both H100 and MI250X. Minimal repro attached in the task run.
Alex: Saw this locally too. CPU-side logs show repeated pagewalk retries, GPU shows long SM stalls around the same timestamps.
Samir: Any pattern on sequence length or batch size?
Maria: Seems to correlate with longcontext > 64k tokens and when we hit the paged-attn path + mixed tiling. Batch size 1/2 both repro.
Li: Interesting — on MI250X we see heavy TLB pressure but also some coherency spikes on the PCIe side when spill/restore happens.
Alex: Dumped a small trace (perf counters + kernel names). Key snippet: 
```
KERNEL: paged_kv_remap (0x7f)  time: 12.3ms  pagewalks: 348  retries: 14
KERNEL: kv_spill_handler    time: 4.9ms   pcie_retries: 6
SM_STALLS: 92%  (wait_on_pt)
```
Maria: Repro steps in case anyone wants to run: use perf-harness v2, model=redwood-open-8k quant=8bit, ctx=120k, run for ~300 iterations. Works on both H100 driver 525.x and MI250X roc-5.x.
Samir: I tried toggling prefix cache heuristics — disabling async prefetch reduces the stalls but increases token latency. Might indicate a race between eviction and remap.
Li: On MI250X the page-table update trace shows "stale-owner" entries occasionally — possibly stale mapping not cleared before a new mapping applied.
Maria: Stack trace from a failing iteration (short): 
```
#0  kv_pagetable_walk at pagetable.c:412
#1  paged_kv_fetch at kvcache.c:1289
#2  kernel_loop at gpu_runtime.cu:221
```
Alex: Could be ordering issue around writeback + invalidation across the CPU/GPU boundary. We saw similar once with NVLINK ordering on multi-GPU but this is single-GPU too.
perf-bot: [CI] nightly-longctx-h100: failed 1/3 runs (kv-page-stall) — triage label added.
Maria: Quick experiment idea: add a small fence after remap and before eviction completion, see if it prevents retries. Will try on both archs.
Samir: If a fence helps, we should also measure perf cost. If it's a correctness hazard, adding a lightweight rw-barrier might be acceptable.
Li: I can reproduce the stale-owner entries with a debug build and instrumented page table. Sending a trace link: https://internal/perf/trace/1765432109 (private).
Alex: Any chance this is related to slotmap fragmentation? We sometimes leave holes that confuse the remap code.
Maria: I added logging for PT owner id during repro — sometimes owner jumps to 0xffffffff then back. That looks like a transient invalidation race.
Samir: Good catch. I can try a patch to serialize owner updates: update-owner -> write-mapping -> publish. If that fixes, we'll need to benchmark.
Maria: For immediate mitigation, can we turn off paged-attn fallback on dedicated until we have a fix? Might be safe for a short window.
Alex: Ops/Deploy: if we disable it, we'll lose some memory wins but reduce incidents. I'll open a deploy PR but need signoff.
Li: Also check how this interacts with our cache eviction policy — if eviction schedules while remap in-flight, we can race.
Maria: I'll push a debug branch with extra fenced updates and a repro script. tagging @eng-runtime for visibility. :eyes:
Alex: Thanks — if you post the branch link I'll run on our A100 lab too.
Samir: Plan: Maria pushes debug patch -> run on H100/MI250X -> if fence fixes, evaluate perf cost -> design ordered owner publish with minimal overhead.
Maria: Uploaded branch: git/infra/kvcache/paged-fence-debug. Running tests now, will update in thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
